name: STAR Geodesy — look angles from a ground site (ENU, azimuth/elevation/range)
summary: ECEF to/from local East-North-Up and azimuth/elevation/range at a WGS-84 site: the geometry of ground-station visibility. Every function returns three finite floats or raises ValueError.
reference: EPSG Guidance Note 7-2, Geocentric/topocentric conversions (EPSG method 9836) example: origin 55 N, 5 E, h 200 m; X 3771793.968, Y 140253.342, Z 5124304.349 -> U -189013.869, V -128642.040, W -4220.171
reference_observed: forward within 3.1e-4 m of the printed values (printed to 1 mm), reverse and origin ECEF within 1 mm

na.G-14: no performance requirement declared by any user

review.G-03: ecef_to_enu, enu_to_ecef, enu_to_aer, aer_to_enu, ecef_to_aer, aer_to_ecef
review.G-04: degrees and metres; azimuth from North towards East in [0, 360); elevation from the horizontal plane; WGS-84 constants pinned in the tests
review.G-06: no external data; cross-check corpus generated with a fixed seed
review.G-08: pure functions, standard library only, no IO
review.G-13: ValueError for every invalid input and for overflow; no iteration, no unbounded loop
